scope: Independent literature, numbering and argument review for MEL5 replacement; no manuscript or figure edits.

primary_facts.case_peptide_modification: Anchor-optimized decamer position 2 Ala-to-Leu, corresponding to MART-1 A27L; same modified peptide in both complexes.
primary_facts.A27L_verification: 2013 source identifies a heteroclitic MART-1 26-35 decamer; existing 2011 primary source gives natural sequence and position-2 modification, directly confirming the numbering.
primary_facts.engineering: Phage display affinity maturation of MEL5 to alpha24beta17
primary_facts.substitution_count_meaning: Nineteen changed residues across recognition loops and nearby frameworks, not nineteen receptor variants.
primary_facts.SPR_parent_koff: >0.1 s^-1; too fast to determine accurately
primary_facts.kinetic_interpretation: Slower dissociation, rather than the ambiguous literal translation of extended off-rate.
primary_facts.I53F_contact_scope: Whole MHC surface, not all Q72-specific contacts.
primary_facts.thermodynamics: Temperature-dependent SPR identifies favorable total binding entropy, discussed mainly through solvent reorganization; this cannot be substituted with bound-state sidechain Hchi.

mechanism_readouts_verified.ITrace_MD_provenance: Three existing 200 ns independent replicas per state, 0-200 ns, all saved frames; separate from the 2013 paper.

prose_v49_review.overall: Primary facts, residue numbering, model values, MD source and main joint-output mechanism are correct, with the corrections below.

necessary_correction.issue: The current sentence may imply both betaCDR2 and betaCDR3 gain contacts; the original table gives betaCDR3 contacts 36 to 30.
